name: Everyday Backpack
description: A 20-liter pack with a padded laptop sleeve, a water bottle pocket and straps that stay put on a bike.

name: Weekender Duffel
description: Waxed canvas, leather handles and a separate shoe compartment. Fits most overhead bins.

name: Canvas Tote
description: Heavy cotton canvas with an inside pocket for keys. Holds a week of groceries.

name: Merino Crew Sweater
description: Fine-gauge merino wool that keeps you warm without bulk. Machine washable on a cold cycle.

name: Packable Rain Shell
description: A waterproof, breathable jacket that packs into its own pocket. Taped seams and an adjustable hood.

name: Organic Cotton Tee
description: A relaxed-fit t-shirt in soft organic cotton, garment dyed so it will not shrink.

name: Trail Runners
description: Grippy lugs, a rock plate and a roomy toe box for long days on rough trails.

name: Leather Sneakers
description: Full-grain leather uppers on a stitched rubber sole. They get better with every wear.

name: Wool Hiking Socks
description: Cushioned merino socks that stay dry and do not smell after a long hike. Sold as a pair.

name: Insulated Bottle
description: Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Stainless steel with a leakproof lid.

name: Pour-Over Coffee Set
description: A ceramic dripper, a glass carafe and 100 paper filters. Everything you need for a better cup.

name: Cast Iron Skillet
description: A pre-seasoned 10-inch skillet that goes from the stove to the oven to the campfire.

name: Enamel Camp Mug
description: A classic enamel mug that holds 12 ounces and survives being dropped on rocks.

name: Two-Person Tent
description: A freestanding tent with two doors and two vestibules. Sets up in five minutes and weighs 1.6 kg.

name: Down Sleeping Bag
description: Rated to -5 °C with responsibly sourced 650-fill down. Compresses to the size of a loaf of bread.

name: Rechargeable Headlamp
description: 350 lumens, a red night mode and a USB-C battery that lasts a whole weekend.

name: Folding Camp Chair
description: Packs down to the size of a water bottle and holds up to 145 kg.

name: Linen Throw Blanket
description: Stonewashed European linen that is light in summer and layers well in winter.

name: Ceramic Planter
description: A hand-glazed planter with a drainage hole and a matching saucer. Fits a 15 cm pot.

name: Brass Desk Lamp
description: A solid brass lamp with an adjustable arm and a warm, dimmable LED bulb included.
